# ThumbGate

> ThumbGate is the local-first pre-action governance runtime for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Amp, Cline, OpenCode, and MCP-compatible tools. Thumbs-down feedback becomes history-aware lessons and PreToolUse checks that catch repeated mistakes before the next tool call. Stripe Connect marketplace engineering is a founder proof point, not the primary product category.

## June 2026 Buyer Signal

- MCP and hosted tool adoption make agent actions more dangerous because a bad response can become a real shell, file, database, payment, or cloud action.
- Managed agents and background coding agents need receipts: which action was blocked, what evidence was required, and why it was allowed or denied.
- Token-spend pressure makes unlimited-context dumping less attractive; ThumbGate sells scoped recall, search, context gating, and proof exports.
- AI-authored production code raises audit expectations; ThumbGate maps corrections to rules and records enforcement evidence.
- Memory-first runtimes such as Letta and Mem0 create more durable agents; ThumbGate complements them with scoped corrective memory, entity-linked recall, lifecycle decay, and pre-action enforcement.

## Core

- [Leash web control and cloud continuation](https://thumbgate.ai/leash): Free browser control for a paired Hermes machine, with an optional $10/month managed cloud runner for work that must continue while the machine is offline. The hosted control plane is in preview; availability and revenue are not implied by this description.
- [Pricing](https://thumbgate.ai/pricing): Free local CLI with 2 captures/day, 10 total captures, and 3 active rules; Pro $19/mo or $149/yr; Workflow Hardening Sprint is intake-led and custom-scoped.
- [Pro checkout](https://thumbgate.ai/checkout/pro): Personal enforcement proof, recall, managed adapter coverage, dashboard evidence, DPO export.
- [Workflow Hardening Sprint](https://thumbgate.ai/#workflow-sprint-intake): Intake-led offer for one repeated AI-agent failure, one workflow owner, and one proof plan.
- [Setup guide](https://thumbgate.ai/guide): `npx thumbgate init` for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode.
- [Comparison](https://thumbgate.ai/compare): vs CLAUDE.md, ESLint, manual code review, Mem0, SpecLock.
- [About](https://thumbgate.ai/about): Founder context and positioning.
- [Full LLM context](https://thumbgate.ai/llm-context.md): Long-form machine-readable description.
